title: WPMS/156/2014 of Smt. Rajmati Gusain AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 156 of 2014
Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Mr. A.K. Bansal, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Ms. Seema Sah, Brief Holder for the
State.
Mr. Vinay Bhatt, Advocate holding
brief of Mr. A.K. Arya, Advocate for the
respondent no.4.
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, Advocate for
the respondent no.5.
Heard.
A lease deed was executed on
12.11.1976 in favour of Mr. Chandan
Singh, which was cancelled on
08.12.1982. The plot was allotted to one
Mr. Surender Bhatia. He was directed to
enter into the supplementary lease deed.
However, he did not enter into the
supplementary lease deed but kept on
depositing the instalments.
Thereafter, on 22.04.2001, one Mr.
Manohar Lal Bhatia was made partner.
The supplementary lease deed was made
to this effect on 03.10.2001.
Thereafter, on 22.10.2003, an
application was moved for division of plot
in two parts. In the meantime, both the
partners Mr. Surender Bhatia and
Manohar Lal Bhatia died.
Thereafter, the legal heirs of Mr.
Surender Bhatia and Mr. Manohar Lal
Bhatia have moved an application for
registration in supplementary lease deeds.
This was allowed on 06.08.2013 by
imposing certain conditions.
There is no illegality in the impugned
order, since the lease deed, executed in

favour of Mr. Chandan Singh on
12.11.1976, was cancelled on 08.12.1982
Plot was allotted to Mr. Surender
Singh. He was inducted a new partner Mr.
Manohar Lal Bhatia. Supplementary lease
deed was executed on 03.10.2001.
Petitioners have no right to assail the order
dated 06.08.2013.
Accordingly, there is no merit in this
petition and the same is hereby dismissed.
